title: Reflect – AI Note-Taking App
description: Minimal, warm-toned personal productivity page. Uses a clean white background with soft gradient hero and subtle floating UI elements. Serif headings give it a thoughtful, journal-like feel. Gentle scroll animations and a simple two-column feature layout. App store buttons prominently placed. The live site uses a hero_soft, features_twocolumn, testimonials, app_download, footer structure with strong visual hierarchy and smooth scroll-triggered animations throughout. Navigation is clean and unobtrusive. The color palette and typography work together to create a cohesive brand experience that aligns with the product category.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for reflect-style products.
